notes.compiler_settings: Matches aave/aave-v4 foundry.toml profile.default: solc 0.8.28, evm cancun, optimizer true, optimizer_runs 44444444, bytecode_hash none. via_ir is false (default profile; hub/spoke instances use via_ir separately and are out of scope for these pure math libraries).
notes.calculateLinearInterestAt: The wrapper exposes a 3-arg pure variant of MathUtils.calculateLinearInterest. Upstream is `view` (reads block.timestamp); the wrapper takes `currentTimestamp` explicitly so the revm test is deterministic without env-pinning.
